_note: COST-MODEL VALIDATION, coarse-region variant of validate_apr6_ts2.json. Identical in every respect (apr6 15:05-15:35 decoded window, time_scale=2.0, c=64, single gorgo-2d policy with the paper's frozen weights) except that the three L40S:2 replicas are pinned to continents (ap / eu / us) instead of ap-seoul-1 / eu-frankfurt-1 / us-ashburn-1, because L40S:2 in those specific datacenters is frequently unschedulable. Same GPU tier and tp=2, so prefill and queue rates remain comparable to the paper's fleet; what changes is that exact placement -- and therefore the precise per-replica RTT -- varies run to run, so report measured RTT per replica rather than quoting the paper's 26-466 ms spread. Requires REQUEST_TIMING_LOG=1 at launch so each replica emits per-request scheduler timings joined to proxy trace rows by rid.
